summary: Pipeline framework: declarative multi-step data pipelines with DAG ordering, typed parameter binding via ParamSpec, caching via PipelineStorage, and integration with the relation AST via PipelineStepRelNode + ParamsRelNode. Fluent builder API: PipelineBuilder.step(...).build() -> PipelineSpec -> SimplePipelineRunner.run(). Parameter binding via relation.params(key=value) replaces the former pushdown capability system.
extension_points: ParamSpec defines typed parameters a step accepts; validated at .params() call time
PipelineStorage protocol for custom caching backends
lifecycle_notes: New module 2026-05: full pipeline orchestration with relation integration

2026-05 (PR #160): Pushdown capability system (StepCapabilities, PushableParam, PushedPredicates, apply_pushdown, pushdown.py) removed; replaced with dict-based ParamSpec system. StepDefinition.capabilities -> .params; StepContext.predicates -> .params; PipelineExecutor.predicates -> .params. ParamsRelNode added to pipelines.integration.relation for relation.params() AST node.
documentation_hooks: Pipeline integrates with relations via source() which returns a Relation wrapping PipelineStepRelNode
Parameter binding: relation.params(key=value) wraps the node in a ParamsRelNode; fold_params() validates and merges into PipelineStepRelNode.bound_params at collect time
Removed: pushdown optimisation; params are now explicit caller-supplied values, not inferred from filter predicates

tests.detail: ~20 test files covering builder, spec, executor, params, storage, orchestration

risks: Evolving module — API surface may still change as params system matures

evidence.detail: Exports step, PipelineBuilder, source; auto-registers pipeline bridge and params optimisation
ParamSpec: frozen dataclass with name, type, required, default
StepDefinition.params: tuple[ParamSpec, ...]; step() decorator accepts params kwarg
